title: Cam Skattebo misses practice due to a hamstring injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo misses practice due to a hamstring injury
sources.description: Giants running back Cam Skattebo said he felt something in his hamstring near the end of the team's Week 7 win over the Texans and it's still an issue coming out of the team's bye week.
